"""Rebuild paper figures from saved summaries, without new simulation."""
import argparse
import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path
import warnings

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.ticker import MaxNLocator, FuncFormatter, NullFormatter
import numpy as np

COLORS = ["#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#009E73", "#CC79A7", "#E69F00"]
SCHEMES = ("independent", "shared")
PAPER_SIZE = (3.35, 3.25)


def style(scheme):
    return dict(linestyle="-" if scheme == "independent" else "--",
                marker="o" if scheme == "independent" else "s",
                markerfacecolor=None if scheme == "independent" else "none",
                markersize=4.5, linewidth=1.5, markeredgewidth=1.0)


def scheme_handles(schemes=SCHEMES):
    return [Line2D([], [], color="#333333", label=s.capitalize(), **style(s)) for s in schemes]


def legend(fig, handles, y, ncol, x=.55):
    fig.legend(handles=handles, loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(x, y), ncol=ncol,
               columnspacing=.8, handlelength=1.6, handletextpad=.4, frameon=False, fontsize=9)


def finish(fig, path, quick):
    # Short log ranges otherwise acquire long, densely packed minor labels.
    for ax in fig.axes:
        for axis, limits in [(ax.xaxis, ax.get_xlim()), (ax.yaxis, ax.get_ylim())]:
            axis.set_minor_formatter(NullFormatter())
            if limits[1] / limits[0] < 10:
                axis.set_major_locator(MaxNLocator(nbins=3, integer=axis is ax.xaxis))
                axis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda value, pos: f"{value:.3g}"))
    if quick:
        fig.text(.5, .01, "Smoke test: not paper results", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9, color="#777777")
    # Keep the physical publication size; tight bounding boxes change the canvas.
    for extension in ("pdf", "png"):
        fig.savefig(path.with_suffix("." + extension), dpi=300)
    plt.close(fig)


def setup(ax, xlabel, ylabel):
    ax.set(xscale="log", yscale="log", xlabel=xlabel, ylabel=ylabel)
    ax.grid(True, which="major", alpha=0.22)
    ax.tick_params(which="both", direction="in", labelsize=9)


def single_panel():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=PAPER_SIZE)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=.22, right=.97, bottom=.19, top=.73)
    return fig, ax


def curve(ax, rows, xkey, label, color, scheme, ykey="error_q90"):
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: r["L"])
    x = np.array([r[xkey] for r in rows])
    y = np.array([r[ykey] for r in rows])
    bad = ~np.isfinite(y) | (y <= 0)
    if np.any(bad):
        warnings.warn(f"{label}: {bad.sum()} undefined/nonpositive values; gaps shown")
    y[bad] = np.nan
    ax.plot(x, y, color=color, label=label, **style(scheme))
    return x, y


def guide(ax, x, y, exponent, label, skip_last=0):
    """Prescribed reference slope; log-mean vertical placement, no slope regression."""
    good = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y) & (y > 0) & (x > 0)
    fit = good.copy()
    if skip_last:
        fit[-skip_last:] = False
    if np.count_nonzero(fit) >= 2:
        amplitude = np.mean(np.log(y[fit]) - exponent * np.log(x[fit]))
        xx = np.sort(x[good])
        reference, = ax.plot(xx, np.exp(amplitude + exponent * np.log(xx)),
                             color="#777777", ls=":", lw=1.5)
        ax.legend(handles=[reference], labels=[label + " ref."], markerfirst=False,
                  loc="lower left", bbox_to_anchor=(.03, .06), borderaxespad=0,
                  handlelength=2.4, handletextpad=.5, fontsize=9,
                  facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", framealpha=.8, borderpad=.2)


def error_plots(name, rows, cfg, directory, quick):
    ylabel = (r"Eigenvalue error $\varepsilon_{0.90}$" if name == "eigenvalue"
              else r"Observable error $\varepsilon_{O,0.90}$")
    fig, ax = single_panel()
    setup(ax, r"Initial states per side $L=R$", ylabel)
    for i, scheme in enumerate(SCHEMES):
        selected = [r for r in rows if r["scheme"] == scheme and r["N"] == cfg["fixed_N"]]
        x, y = curve(ax, selected, "L", scheme.capitalize(), COLORS[i], scheme)
        if scheme == "independent":
            guide(ax, x, y, -1, r"$L^{-1}$", skip_last=3 if name == "eigenvalue" else 0)
    ax.set_title(f"Fixed N = {cfg['fixed_N']}", fontsize=10, pad=7)
    legend(fig, ax.get_legend_handles_labels()[0], .96, 1)
    finish(fig, directory / f"{name}_error_vs_state_count", quick)

    fig, ax = single_panel()
    setup(ax, r"Total evolution time $T_{\mathrm{total}}$", ylabel)
    for i, N in enumerate(cfg["N_values"]):
        for scheme in SCHEMES:
            selected = [r for r in rows if r["scheme"] == scheme and r["N"] == N]
            x, y = curve(ax, selected, "mean_total_time", f"{scheme}, N={N}", COLORS[i], scheme)
            if N == cfg["fixed_N"] and scheme == "independent":
                guide(ax, x, y, -.5, r"$T_{\mathrm{total}}^{-1/2}$", skip_last=3 if name == "eigenvalue" else 0)
    handles = [Line2D([], [], color=COLORS[i], lw=2, label=rf"$N={N}$") for i, N in enumerate(cfg["N_values"])]
    legend(fig, handles, .995, 3, x=.52)
    legend(fig, scheme_handles(), .90, 2)
    finish(fig, directory / f"{name}_error_vs_total_time", quick)


def threshold_range(ax, x, lower, upper, tau=None):
    """Show an inset illustrative tau band, not the full admissible interval.

    Leave 15% of the logarithmic gap at either singular-value boundary.
    Bounds come from mean spectra, not confidence or per-trial guarantees.
    """
    valid = np.isfinite(lower) & np.isfinite(upper) & (lower > 0) & (upper > lower)
    inset_lower = np.full_like(lower, np.nan, dtype=float)
    inset_upper = np.full_like(upper, np.nan, dtype=float)
    gap = np.log(upper[valid]) - np.log(lower[valid])
    inset_lower[valid] = np.exp(np.log(lower[valid]) + .15 * gap)
    inset_upper[valid] = np.exp(np.log(upper[valid]) - .15 * gap)
    color = "#52687A"
    boundary, = ax.plot(x, inset_lower, color=color, ls="--", lw=1.1,
                        label=r"Illustrative $\tau$ band", zorder=3)
    ax.plot(x, inset_upper, color=color, ls="--", lw=1.1, zorder=3)
    ax.fill_between(x, inset_lower, inset_upper, where=valid,
                    color=color, alpha=.10, linewidth=0, zorder=1)
    handles = [boundary]
    if tau is not None:
        chosen = np.full_like(inset_lower, tau)
        fixed, = ax.plot(x, chosen, color="black", ls="-.", lw=1,
                         label=rf"$\tau={tau:g}$", zorder=4)
        handles.append(fixed)
        # A value outside the inset band can still be admissible: test the full gap.
        outside = valid & ((tau < lower) | (tau >= upper))
        ax.plot(x[outside], chosen[outside], ls="none", marker="x", color="red", markersize=6,
                zorder=5)
    return handles


def multiplicity_plot(rows, cfg, directory, quick, tau=None):
    """One identical-layout 1x2 figure per scheme; never mix scheme rows."""
    if tau is not None and (not np.isfinite(tau) or tau <= 0):
        raise ValueError("tau must be finite and positive")
    for scheme in SCHEMES:
        selected = sorted([r for r in rows if r.get("scheme", "independent") == scheme],
                          key=lambda r: r["L"])
        if not selected:
            warnings.warn(f"No {scheme} multiplicity data; skipping its singular-value figure.")
            continue
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(6.8, 3.3), sharey=True)
        fig.subplots_adjust(left=.105, right=.98, bottom=.19, top=.74, wspace=.13)
        for cluster, ax in enumerate(axes):
            setup(ax, r"Initial states per side $L=R$", r"Normalized singular value $s_k/L$" if cluster == 0 else "")
            ax.set_ylim(2e-3, .4)
            for k, color in enumerate(COLORS, 1):
                x, y = curve(ax, selected, "L", f"s{k}, {scheme}", color, scheme, f"sv_{cluster}_{k}")
                if k == 4 and scheme == "independent":
                    guide(ax, x[x >= 24], y[x >= 24], -.5, r"$L^{-1/2}$")
            # Older saved runs predate explicit evaluation centers.
            center = cfg.get("evaluation_centers", np.unique(cfg["eigenvalues"]))[cluster]
            multiplicity = np.count_nonzero(np.asarray(cfg["eigenvalues"]) == center)
            lower = np.array([r[f"sv_{cluster}_{multiplicity + 1}"] for r in selected])
            upper = np.array([r[f"sv_{cluster}_{multiplicity}"] for r in selected])
            tau_handles = threshold_range(ax, x, lower, upper, tau)
            ax.set_title(rf"Target ${center:g}$; multiplicity {multiplicity}", fontsize=10)
        handles = [Line2D([], [], color=c, lw=2, label=rf"$s_{k}/L$") for k, c in enumerate(COLORS, 1)]
        legend(fig, handles, 1.0, 5, x=.53)
        legend(fig, scheme_handles([scheme]) + tau_handles, .91, 1 + len(tau_handles), x=.53)
        finish(fig, directory / f"multiplicity_singular_values_vs_state_count_{scheme}", quick)


def read_run(path):
    meta = json.loads((path / "metadata.json").read_text())
    with (path / "summary.csv").open(newline="") as stream:
        rows = [{k: v if k in {"scheme", "evaluation_mode"} else float(v) for k, v in row.items()}
                for row in csv.DictReader(stream)]
    return meta, rows


def plot_run(path, tau=None):
    path = Path(path)
    meta, rows = read_run(path)
    if not rows:
        raise ValueError("No completed results to plot")
    directory = path / "figures"
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    plt.rcParams.update({"font.size": 9, "axes.labelsize": 10, "axes.titlesize": 10,
                         "legend.fontsize": 9, "xtick.labelsize": 9, "ytick.labelsize": 9,
                         "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False, "pdf.fonttype": 42})
    if meta["experiment"] == "multiplicity":
        if meta.get("evaluation_mode") not in {"exact_cluster_centers", "estimated_cluster_centers"}:
            raise ValueError("Unsupported multiplicity evaluation mode; use a new run directory.")
        if any(f"sv_{c}_5" not in row for row in rows for c in range(2)):
            raise ValueError("Saved multiplicity summary lacks s5/L; rerun in a new output directory.")
        multiplicity_plot(rows, meta["config"], directory, meta["quick"], tau=tau)
    else:
        error_plots(meta["experiment"], rows, meta["config"], directory, meta["quick"])
    print(f"Figures saved to {directory}", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("run_directory", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--tau", type=float, help="Normalized singular-value threshold guide (multiplicity only)")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    plot_run(args.run_directory, tau=args.tau)

"""Experiment execution, reproducible seeds, and incremental result files."""
import argparse
import csv
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor

# One BLAS thread per worker avoids oversubscription on typical laptops.
os.environ.setdefault("OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "1")
os.environ.setdefault("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "1")
os.environ.setdefault("MKL_NUM_THREADS", "1")

import numpy as np
import scipy
from qfames.core import (initial_states, spectral_samples, filtered_matrix,
                         find_peaks, observable_filtered, observable_eigenvalues,
                         matching_error, observable_initial_states, observable_target_peak)

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
EXPERIMENT_IDS = {"eigenvalue": 1, "multiplicity": 2, "observable": 3}
BASE_FIELDS = ["scheme", "N", "L", "trial", "status", "error", "peak_error",
               "spectral_time", "observable_time", "total_time", "max_time",
               "peak_0", "peak_1", "projected_condition", "max_imaginary",
               "message"]
SV_FIELDS = [f"sv_{cluster}_{k}" for cluster in range(2) for k in range(1, 6)]
FIELDS = BASE_FIELDS + SV_FIELDS
EVALUATION_FIELDS = ["evaluation_mode", "evaluation_theta_0", "evaluation_theta_1"]
COST_CONVENTION_VERSION = 2
COST_CONVENTION = (
    "absolute sampled evolution time; two tests (real and imaginary) per complex datum; "
    "shared times counted for every state pair; observable cost includes both legs"
)


def source_record():
    """Keep portable source hashes and their source text inside existing metadata."""
    sources = {p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(): p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
               for folder in ("qfames", "experiments")
               for p in sorted((ROOT / folder).glob("*.py"))}
    return dict(code_sha256={name: hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
                             for name, text in sources.items()},
                source_snapshot=sources,
                source_hash_convention="SHA256 of UTF-8 Python source with LF newlines and POSIX relative paths")


def run_trial(job):
    name, cfg, scheme, N, L, trial = job
    seed = [cfg["seed"], EXPERIMENT_IDS[name], L, N, trial]
    state_rng = np.random.default_rng(np.random.SeedSequence(seed + [0]))
    scheme_id = 1 if scheme == "independent" else 2
    rng = np.random.default_rng(np.random.SeedSequence(seed + [scheme_id]))
    obs_rng = np.random.default_rng(np.random.SeedSequence(seed + [scheme_id + 2]))
    row = dict.fromkeys(FIELDS, "")
    row.update(scheme=scheme, N=N, L=L, trial=trial, status="ok", error=np.inf,
               peak_error=np.inf, spectral_time=0.0, observable_time=0.0,
               total_time=0.0, max_time=0.0)
    spectrum = np.array(cfg["eigenvalues"])
    centers = np.unique(spectrum if name == "observable" else cfg["dominant_eigenvalues"])
    if name == "observable":
        phi, psi = observable_initial_states(L, L, cfg.get("state_weights"))
    else:
        phi, psi = initial_states(state_rng, len(cfg["dominant_eigenvalues"]), L, L,
                                  replicated=name == "eigenvalue",
                                  min_overlap=cfg["min_overlap"])
        # Apply rejection only to the original normalized dominant vectors.
        # The constant single-column tail gives normalized p_tail = tail_weight exactly.
        weight = cfg["tail_weight"]
        phi, psi = (np.column_stack((np.sqrt(1 - weight) * states,
                                    np.full(len(states), np.sqrt(weight))))
                    for states in (phi, psi))
    data = spectral_samples(rng, spectrum, phi, psi, N, cfg["T"], cfg["sigma"],
                            scheme, cfg["noise_std"])
    row.update(spectral_time=data.total_time, total_time=data.total_time,
               max_time=data.max_time)
    if name == "multiplicity":
        row.update(evaluation_mode="estimated_cluster_centers", error=np.nan)
        peaks = find_peaks(data, cfg["T"], len(cfg["evaluation_centers"]),
                           cfg["search_bounds"], cfg["grid_step"], cfg["alpha"], cfg["threshold"])
        if len(peaks) != len(cfg["evaluation_centers"]):
            row.update(status="peak_failure", message=f"Found {len(peaks)} of {len(cfg['evaluation_centers'])} peaks")
            return row
        row["peak_error"] = matching_error(peaks, cfg["evaluation_centers"])
        for cluster, theta in enumerate(peaks):
            row[f"peak_{cluster}"] = float(theta)
            row[f"evaluation_theta_{cluster}"] = float(theta)
            singular = np.linalg.svd(filtered_matrix(data, theta), compute_uv=False)
            for k in range(1, 6):
                row[f"sv_{cluster}_{k}"] = singular[k - 1] / L
        return row
    if name == "observable":
        opt = observable_target_peak(data, cfg.get("search_bounds", [-0.04, 0.04]))
        row.update(optimizer_success=bool(opt.success), optimizer_nfev=opt.nfev,
                   optimizer_message=str(opt.message))
        if not opt.success or not np.isfinite(opt.x) or not np.isfinite(opt.fun):
            row.update(status="peak_failure", message=str(opt.message))
            return row
        theta = float(opt.x)
        row.update(peak_0=theta, peak_error=abs(theta - centers[0]))
    else:
        peaks = find_peaks(data, cfg["T"], len(centers), cfg["search_bounds"],
                           cfg["grid_step"], cfg["alpha"], cfg["threshold"])
        if len(peaks) != len(centers):
            row.update(status="peak_failure", message=f"Found {len(peaks)} of {len(centers)} peaks")
            return row
        row.update(peak_0=peaks[0], peak_1=peaks[1], peak_error=matching_error(peaks, centers))
    if name == "eigenvalue":
        row["error"] = row["peak_error"]
    else:
        # The target is the lower cluster, whose multiplicity is assumed known.
        base = filtered_matrix(data, theta)
        del data
        observable = np.array(cfg["observable"], dtype=complex)
        filtered, obs_cost, obs_max = observable_filtered(
            obs_rng, spectrum, phi, psi, observable, N, cfg["T"], cfg["sigma"],
            scheme, cfg["observable_noise_std"], theta, cfg["chunk_size"])
        row.update(observable_time=obs_cost, total_time=row["spectral_time"] + obs_cost,
                   max_time=max(row["max_time"], obs_max))
        try:
            estimates, condition = observable_eigenvalues(base, filtered, cfg["multiplicity"])
            row.update(error=matching_error(estimates, cfg["observable_targets"]),
                       projected_condition=condition,
                       max_imaginary=float(np.max(np.abs(estimates.imag))))
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError as exc:
            row.update(status="eigensolver_failure", message=str(exc))
    return row


def key(row):
    return row["scheme"], int(row["N"]), int(row["L"]), int(row["trial"])


def summarize(raw_path, output):
    with raw_path.open(newline="") as stream:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(stream))
    groups = {}
    for row in rows:
        groups.setdefault(key(row)[:3], []).append(row)
    summaries = []
    for (scheme, N, L), group in sorted(groups.items()):
        errors = np.array([float(r["error"]) for r in group])
        item = dict(scheme=scheme, N=N, L=L, trials=len(group),
                    failed=sum(r["status"] != "ok" for r in group),
                    error_q90=float(np.quantile(errors, 0.9, method="inverted_cdf")))
        for field in ["total_time", "spectral_time", "observable_time"]:
            item["mean_" + field] = float(np.mean([float(r[field]) for r in group]))
        item["max_time"] = max(float(r["max_time"]) for r in group)
        for field in SV_FIELDS:
            vals = [float(r[field]) for r in group if r[field] != ""]
            item[field] = float(np.mean(vals)) if vals else np.nan
        if group[0].get("evaluation_mode") == "estimated_cluster_centers":
            item["evaluation_mode"] = "estimated_cluster_centers"
            for field in EVALUATION_FIELDS[1:]:
                vals = [float(r[field]) for r in group if r[field] != ""]
                item[field] = float(np.mean(vals)) if vals else np.nan
        summaries.append(item)
    if summaries:
        with output.open("w", newline="") as stream:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(summaries[0]))
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(summaries)
    return summaries


def validate_config(name, cfg):
    if name in {"eigenvalue", "multiplicity"}:
        if (len(cfg["tail_eigenvalues"]) != 1 or not 0 < cfg["tail_weight"] < 1
                or cfg["eigenvalues"] != cfg["dominant_eigenvalues"] + cfg["tail_eigenvalues"]):
            raise ValueError("Spectrum must contain dominant eigenvalues followed by one tail, with 0 < tail_weight < 1")
    if cfg["trials"] < 1 or cfg["seed"] < 0:
        raise ValueError("trials must be positive; seed must be nonnegative")
    minimum = 5 if name == "multiplicity" else (3 if name == "observable" else 2)
    if len(set(cfg["L_values"])) != len(cfg["L_values"]) or any(L < minimum for L in cfg["L_values"]):
        raise ValueError(f"L_values must be unique integers >= {minimum}")
    if name != "multiplicity" and (len(cfg["N_values"]) != 3 or len(set(cfg["N_values"])) != 3):
        raise ValueError("Provide three distinct N values for the six-curve cost plot")
    if min(cfg["N_values"]) < 2 or cfg["fixed_N"] not in cfg["N_values"]:
        raise ValueError("N >= 2 is required, and fixed_N must occur in N_values")
    if cfg["T"] <= 0 or cfg["sigma"] <= 0 or cfg["noise_std"] < 0:
        raise ValueError("Invalid time scale, truncation, or noise parameter")


def main(name):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=f"QFAMES {name} experiment")
    parser.add_argument("--config", type=Path, default=ROOT / "configs" / f"{name}.json")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, help="Run directory; use a new directory for changed settings")
    parser.add_argument("--quick", action="store_true", help="Small end-to-end check, not paper data")
    parser.add_argument("--trials", type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--resume", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--plot-only", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output = args.output or ROOT / "results" / ("quick" if args.quick else "") / name
    if args.plot_only:
        from qfames.plotting import plot_run
        plot_run(output)
        return
    cfg = json.loads(args.config.read_text())
    if args.quick:
        cfg.update(L_values=[5, 6, 8] if name == "multiplicity" else [4, 6, 8], N_values=[40, 80, 160], fixed_N=80, trials=4)
    if args.trials is not None:
        cfg["trials"] = args.trials
    if args.seed is not None:
        cfg["seed"] = args.seed
    validate_config(name, cfg)
    if args.workers < 1:
        parser.error("--workers must be positive")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    metadata_path = output / "metadata.json"
    raw_path = output / "trials.csv"
    metadata = dict(experiment=name, config=cfg, quick=args.quick, **source_record(),
                    python=platform.python_version(), numpy=np.__version__, scipy=scipy.__version__,
                    cost_convention=COST_CONVENTION, cost_convention_version=COST_CONVENTION_VERSION,
                    workers=args.workers)
    fields = FIELDS + EVALUATION_FIELDS if name == "multiplicity" else FIELDS
    if name == "multiplicity":
        metadata.update(evaluation_mode="estimated_cluster_centers",
                        target_centers=list(cfg["evaluation_centers"]),
                        sampling_schemes=["independent", "shared"],
                        field_description="sv_<cluster>_<k>: s_k/L at estimated peaks (summary: successful peak-search trial mean); peak fields record estimates")
    if name == "observable":
        fields = FIELDS + ["optimizer_success", "optimizer_nfev", "optimizer_message"]
        metadata.update(initial_state_mode="deterministic_correlated_frame",
                        peak_search_mode="known_target_neighborhood",
                        target_search_bounds=cfg.get("search_bounds", [-0.04, 0.04]), target_search_xatol=1e-10,
                        known_target_multiplicity=cfg["multiplicity"])
    completed = set()
    if metadata_path.exists() or raw_path.exists():
        if not args.resume or not metadata_path.exists() or not raw_path.exists():
            parser.error("Output exists. Use --resume for the same settings, or choose a new --output.")
        old = json.loads(metadata_path.read_text())
        if (old.get("cost_convention_version") != COST_CONVENTION_VERSION
                or "cost_correction" in old.get("postprocessing", {})
                or "source_snapshot" not in old):
            parser.error("Historical results cannot be resumed. Use --plot-only, or a new --output to simulate.")
        if any(old.get(k) != metadata[k] for k in
               ("experiment", "config", "code_sha256", "source_snapshot", "source_hash_convention",
                "python", "numpy", "scipy")):
            parser.error("Resume requires unchanged settings, source code, Python, NumPy, and SciPy.")
        with raw_path.open(newline="") as stream:
            completed = {key(row) for row in csv.DictReader(stream)}
    else:
        metadata_path.write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        with raw_path.open("w", newline="") as stream:
            csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=fields).writeheader()
